notes: CI-only config: skips int8_tflite. See the 'Known platform limitation' note in CLAUDE.md/README — TensorFlow Lite's native calibrator crashes with SIGFPE during INT8 calibration on the GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest runner (tensorflow==2.21.0), while working correctly on macOS. examples/config.json (the real example) is unaffected and keeps int8_tflite.
